open_world.dialogue: Howdy, partner. Welcome to the Dustline.
open_world.quest_offer: Made it out to the frontier, huh? Good. The Dustline's held on two hundred years without the Core's help, and it'll keep holding! BUT the noticeboard at the saloon fell apart, and Mabel could use a hand rebuilding it as a proper site. What you need to do is to buy a simple website that present you as a new builder in pixl!
open_world.quest_done: Good job, partner. The frontier's proud of you.
open_world.trial_reminder: Still on the noticeboard? Get it posting and filterin', log your hours, ship it when it's real. I'll open the ledger.

open_world.dialogue: Hi! I'm Mabel, I lead the saloon but it's pretty hard since the music stop coming... I would really love a bit of help to find a solution!
open_world.quest_offer: I think you are competent enough to build me a custom and original MP3 player! Imagine it as you want it, there is no limit of what it can do/have! Maybe think of a jack port, a screen, buttons or even joysticks or external speakers!! Don't be limited and believe in you to make the most original and beautiful MP3 player for the saloon!
open_world.quest_done: WOW 'm so proud of you, the saloon will revive thanks to that!
open_world.trial_reminder: Is that music that I hear? Oh... It's only in my head... Please build that MP3 as soon as possible builder!
open_world.trial_name: A Music player for the saloon

open_world.dialogue: I really need help to contact more hack clubbers on earth. The problem is that the really went quiet...
open_world.quest_offer: The relay's carried word across the Dustline for two centuries, no wifi, no Core, just radio. Build me a repeater: two physical devices that pass a message across on radio alone. It can be either with morse code or vocal messages, build what you can think of with absolutely no limit!
open_world.quest_done: Good job. The relay's in good hands now.
open_world.trial_reminder: Repeater still in pieces? Two devices, radio only, a screen that clicks when the message lands.
open_world.trial_name: Contact the hackclubbers on earth for more support!

village.dialogue: Yo, you wanna see what you are working on rn? It's right here.
You have any question? Check out the docs, ask in the help channel or just check what I can answer right here!

Hiya builder! I'm Gabin, one of the survivor of the Great Static. Along with my friends Ridit and Ricky, I decided to look for help on the planet help!
That's why you are here today! You should definitely go talk to all the pixelians, they are very friendly and always have trials to give you!
See you soon for more adventures!!
